input.answer: I'd go for Harel's "מניות" track: 24.04% over 3 years and 14.64% over 5, which is way more than the S&P 500 track's 13.7%, and the fee is basically the same (0.55% against 0.56%). I'm not 100% sure though, because S&P is the one everyone at work talks about.

stuck.where: Table, the 'מניות' row vs the 'עוקב מדד S&P 500' row
stuck.why: S&P is the thing I came for, but מניות shows a much bigger return. The fees are almost identical, so the return number decided it. I went back and forth for a moment.

stuck.where: Lots of rows that say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number
stuck.why: Most tracks have no return number at all, so I couldn't compare them. I only looked at the ones that had numbers.
Not sure if 24.04% is for the whole 3 years or per year. I took it as the total. Either way it's higher than the S&P one.
